articles.headline: Celtics' Jayson Tatum caps 40-point night with buzzer-beater in OT vs. Nets
articles.description: Jayson Tatum buried a 17-foot jumper at the overtime buzzer in his first 40-point performance since his return from a torn Achilles as the C's beat the Nets.

articles.headline: Knicks get first win of the season with a 111-97 victory over the previously unbeaten Pistons
articles.description: — Karl-Anthony Towns had 27 points and 20 rebounds, and the New York Knicks avoided what would have been the second 0-4 start by a defending champion in NBA history by beating the previously undefeated Detroit Pistons 111-97 on Tuesday night.
